purpose: Replicate the guided PPO pilot across three independent learner seeds; retain every run.
recipe: Same as the first guided PPO pilot: goal_offset, neutral mean, std .05, guidance on, filter off, reward scale .01, no shaping.
source_differences: Test-only explicit CPU model fixtures and documentation; all training package bytes remain identical.
evaluation_controls: Evaluate each independent run initial and final policy explicitly; no best-seed selection.
registration_timing: Additional seeds committed after first guided training finished, before its completed learned-checkpoint evaluation results are available.
limitations: This is a three-seed 100k feasibility pilot, not the canonical eight-worker million-step matrix.
Development scenarios only; unseen generalization remains outstanding.
All seeds remain visible even if the original seed or replications fail.
High scores from the route prior do not count as learning.
scheduling: Train the two additional runs sequentially, using two simulator workers at a time; existing evaluations continue.
